content:
sam_cs: Quick notes from Bulwark Health call — they raised a few things we should capture for product prioritization:
- Missing per-route cost breakdown in Console; finance team can't allocate spend to teams.
- Embed cache staleness: their search indexes show old embeddings for docs updated hourly.
- Onboarding: sample dataset upload fails intermittently (403-ish) for large files.
They said renewal conversation in 6 weeks; if we don't address cost visibility they may push back.

devin_pm: Can we tag these with severity and estimated effort? I'd mark per-route cost visibility P0 (affects billing), embed staleness P1, upload error P1.

lina_prod: Thanks. For per-route cost, do we have an existing telemetry event that splits tokens by route? If not, need product + eng to scope.

alex_eng: There's an internal metrics event token_route.{route_id}.tokens emitted from proxy, but Console doesn't surface it. Quick win: add UI column + CSV export. I can mock a patch: 
```
SELECT route_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30d'
GROUP BY route_id
```
GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/4521 (draft)

maria_cs: Bulwark quote: "We need to show our execs exactly where spend is going — otherwise we can't justify the renewal uplift." They want a sample CSV this week for their finance review.

alex_eng: I'll open a PR for the CSV export and flag for a canary in Console. ETA for PR review: 3 working days.

devin_pm: Great. Lina, can you own the prioritization doc and add acceptance criteria? I'll move the embed-staleness and upload-error to the next sprint backlog unless product escalates.

lina_prod: Taking it. Acceptance criteria for per-route cost: CSV export with route_id, tokens, cost_estimate; UI column in per-account routes table; tests + docs. Target: ship in 2 weeks.

ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-7892 Bulwark per-route-cost CSV + Console column (linked to GH 4521).

sam_cs: Thanks team — I'll send Bulwark a sample CSV once PR is merged to canary and keep renewal update in the call notes. :thumbsup:
